name: com.agrodiler/catalog
title: Agrodiler
description: Bearings, farm machinery parts and machines for Ukraine and the EU: search, prices, stock, orders.

tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Find products in the agrodiler.com catalog (bearings, spare parts for agricultural machinery, agricultural machines) with the same search as the site search box. Use it first whenever the buyer names a bearing designation (6205-2RS, 32010, UC205, GOST 180205), a part number, a size (25x52x15), a brand or a machine model, or asks what is available or in stock; it is the only way to get the handles the other tools need. Do not use it to get the full details or the binding price of a product you already have a handle for (use get_product or quote). Returns up to limit items: handle, section (bearing, part, machine), title, designation, brand, dimensions_mm, in_stock, stock_qty, price_hint (catalog price in the market currency, not binding), url; plus match, total and note. lang selects the site and market: en (EU, EUR), uk or ru (Ukraine, UAH). match tells how well the query was matched: all_words = every word matched; some_words = only some words matched (check the items); none = nothing found, try another spelling or fewer words; "close_in_size" = the designation was decoded but is not in the catalog; items share d and D (other width or height) and are not exact substitutes. degraded true = number decoding was unavailable and only text search ran, so an empty result may be incomplete: retry later. Read-only: does not reserve stock or change anything.

query.description: Search text, 2 to 100 characters. Required. One of: a bearing designation ("6205-2RS", "32010", "UC205"; a GOST number such as "180205" is converted to ISO), a part number, a size in mm as "d x D x B" ("25x52x15"), a brand with a number ("SKF 6205", "FAG 32010"), a machine model or series ("DEFT 1,8"), or a product name. Spaces and case do not matter ("6205 2rs" = "6205-2RS"). Put only the search words here, not a sentence.

lang.description: Site language and market (optional, default uk). uk = Ukrainian site and ru = Russian site: Ukraine market, prices in UAH, Nova Poshta delivery, no ship_to. en = English site (site root): EU market, prices in EUR excluding VAT, delivery to EU countries, ship_to is required for quote and place_order. Use the market of the buyer; the range, prices and product handles differ between markets, so keep the same lang across search_products, get_product, quote, cart_link and place_order.

section.description: Optional filter by catalog section, default any. any = all sections; bearing = rolling bearings; part = spare parts for agricultural machinery; machine = agricultural machines (implements). The filter is applied to the matches of query, so it only removes other sections from the result.

limit.description: Maximum number of items in the reply, integer from 1 to 20. Optional, default 10. The reply is cut to this count; total shows how many matched.

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Details of one product by its handle (from search_products): title, part number, kind, brand, type, key specifications as label/value pairs (size, stock and similar, up to 12), minimum order quantity (moq), current unit price in the market currency (UAH incl. VAT for uk/ru, EUR excluding VAT for en: quote adds the VAT of the delivery country; price_on_request true and unit_price null = price set by the manager), product page URL and image URL. Use it to check one product before quoting or to show the buyer its specification and minimum quantity. Do not use it to search (use search_products) or to calculate an order total with shipping (use quote). Fails with not_found if the handle is not orderable on the chosen lang site. Read-only.

handle.description: Product handle: the "handle" field of an item returned by search_products (lowercase latin letters, digits, . _ -; e.g. "ct-6205-2rs" for a bearing, "diskator-deft-1-8-pruzhinnaya-stoyka" for a machine). Required; do not invent handles, a handle that is not orderable on the chosen lang site is rejected.

lang.description: Site language and market (optional, default uk). uk = Ukrainian site and ru = Russian site: Ukraine market, prices in UAH, Nova Poshta delivery, no ship_to. en = English site (site root): EU market, prices in EUR excluding VAT, delivery to EU countries, ship_to is required for quote and place_order. Use the market of the buyer; the range, prices and product handles differ between markets, so keep the same lang across search_products, get_product, quote, cart_link and place_order.

tools.name: quote
tools.description: Calculate the binding total for a list of items with the same code the site checkout uses (prices, minimum order, shipping rules: Nova Poshta for Ukraine; for lang en shipping and VAT by the ship_to country, minimum order 49 EUR excl. VAT). Use it after the buyer has chosen products and quantities, and before place_order, to show the exact total. Do not use it to search or to look up one product (search_products, get_product). Returns per line: qty, moq, unit and line amounts in minor units; total_minor and total_display; for lang en also goods, shipping and VAT amounts; shipping terms; min_order_ok (false means the total is below the minimum order: add items). Amounts in *_minor fields are integers in minor units (kopiyky for UAH, euro cents for EUR). Fails if the quantity is below a product minimum order quantity or a handle is not orderable (unknown_skus). Read-only: creates no order. Use the returned total_minor as expected_total_minor in place_order.

handle.description: Product handle: the "handle" field of an item returned by search_products (lowercase latin letters, digits, . _ -; e.g. "ct-6205-2rs" for a bearing, "diskator-deft-1-8-pruzhinnaya-stoyka" for a machine). Required; do not invent handles, a handle that is not orderable on the chosen lang site is rejected.

qty.description: Quantity in pieces: integer from 1 to 9999. Must not be below the product minimum order quantity (moq from get_product).

items.description: Order lines, 1 to 50, e.g. [{"handle": "ct-6205-2rs", "qty": 10}]. Each handle at most once (merge duplicates into one line).

lang.description: Site language and market (optional, default uk). uk = Ukrainian site and ru = Russian site: Ukraine market, prices in UAH, Nova Poshta delivery, no ship_to. en = English site (site root): EU market, prices in EUR excluding VAT, delivery to EU countries, ship_to is required for quote and place_order. Use the market of the buyer; the range, prices and product handles differ between markets, so keep the same lang across search_products, get_product, quote, cart_link and place_order.

ship_to.description: Delivery destination, e.g. {"country": "DE", "postcode": "10115"}. Required when lang is en (EU market: shipping and VAT depend on the country); must be omitted for uk and ru (Ukraine: Nova Poshta, no destination country).

country.description: Delivery country, ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, two uppercase letters (DE, PL, FR…). Shipping cost and VAT are calculated for this country.

postcode.description: Postal code of the delivery address, up to 16 characters, e.g. "10115". Optional; if omitted, the country alone is used.

tools.name: cart_link
tools.description: Build a link that opens agrodiler.com with these items in the cart and the order form shown. Use it when the buyer prefers to finish on the site or your client cannot call place_order. Do not use it to get prices (use quote). Quantities below the minimum order quantity are raised to it; raised_to_moq lists the affected handles. Returns url, the final items and a note. Fails with unknown_skus if a handle is not orderable on the chosen lang site. Does not place an order: nothing is ordered until the buyer submits the form.

Required; do not invent handles, a handle that is not orderable on the chosen lang site is rejected.

tools.name: place_order
tools.description: Submit an order request on behalf of the buyer, only after they approved the items and the quote total, and gave their name and email. No payment is taken and nothing is charged: a 6-digit code is emailed to the buyer; after the buyer confirms (confirm_order or the email link) a manager checks it and contacts them. Call quote first and pass its total_minor as expected_total_minor; if the total changed you get price_changed with the new total. For lang en, ship_to is required. Returns order_number, order_secret (keep it for confirm_order and resend_code), status (awaiting_buyer_code), code_expires_at, total, replay (true if the same idempotency_key returned an existing request) and next steps. idempotency_key is required: reuse it on retries so a lost reply never creates a second request. Do not use it to only show a price (use quote) or when the buyer prefers the site (use cart_link). Use only the buyer's own email with their consent. Limits: 3 requests per hour per buyer email and per network address.

Required; do not invent handles, a handle that is not orderable on the chosen lang site is rejected.

items.description: Order lines, 1 to 50, e.g. [{"handle": "ct-6205-2rs", "qty": 10}]. Each handle at most once (merge duplicates into one line).

Use the market of the buyer; the range, prices and product handles differ between markets, so keep the same lang across search_products, get_product, quote, cart_link and place_order.

ship_to.description: Delivery destination, e.g. {"country": "DE", "postcode": "10115"}. Required when lang is en (EU market: shipping and VAT depend on the country); must be omitted for uk and ru (Ukraine: Nova Poshta, no destination country).

country.description: Delivery country, ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, two uppercase letters (DE, PL, FR…). Shipping cost and VAT are calculated for this country.

postcode.description: Postal code of the delivery address, up to 16 characters, e.g. "10115". Optional; if omitted, the country alone is used.

name.description: Buyer's full name or company contact person, 1 to 120 characters, e.g. "Ivan Petrenko".

email.description: The buyer's own email, up to 254 characters, e.g. "buyer@example.com". The 6-digit confirmation code is sent there, so it must be an address the buyer can read; never use a made-up address.

phone.description: Buyer's phone in international format, e.g. "+380501234567" (digits, spaces, parentheses and hyphens, optional leading +, 7 to 40 characters). Optional; if omitted, the manager uses email only.

contact.description: Buyer contact details: name and email are required, phone is optional. Collect them from the buyer; do not guess them.

delivery.description: Delivery details as free text, up to 1000 characters. Ukraine (uk, ru): city and Nova Poshta branch, e.g. "Kyiv, branch 12". EU (en): street address and city, e.g. "Hauptstrasse 5, Berlin"; the country goes into ship_to. Optional; if omitted, the manager asks the buyer.

comment.description: Any other wishes or notes for the manager, up to 2000 characters. Optional.

expected_total_minor.description: Order total the buyer agreed to: total_minor from the quote reply, an integer in minor units of the market currency (kopiyky for UAH, euro cents for EUR; 150000 = 1500.00). Required. If the total changed since the quote, the order is rejected with price_changed and the new total.

idempotency_key.description: Required. A UUID version 4 that you generate, e.g. "3f2b8c1e-5d4a-4e7b-9a60-1c2d3e4f5a6b". Use a NEW key for each new order request; on a retry of the same request (timeout, lost reply) send the SAME key: you get the same order and its order_secret instead of a duplicate. The same key with different contents is rejected (token_reused).

assistant.description: Name of the assistant placing the order, up to 60 characters (letters, digits, space and . _ ( ) / -), e.g. "Claude" or "ChatGPT". Optional; shown to the manager as the order source. Dots and slashes are replaced with spaces.

tools.name: confirm_order
tools.description: Confirm an order request with the 6-digit code the buyer received by email, plus order_number and order_secret from place_order. Use it after place_order, when the buyer tells you the code. Do not call it without a code from the buyer; never guess it. Returns status: verified (sent to the manager), already (was confirmed before), invalid (wrong data; attempts_left shows how many tries remain), locked, expired (call resend_code); plus a message. 8 attempts per order request in total (a resent code does not reset them). After confirmation the request goes to a manager; no payment is taken.

order_number.description: order_number from the place_order reply: a positive integer, e.g. 1042.

order_secret.description: order_secret from the place_order reply: 32 lowercase hexadecimal characters. Pass it exactly as received; it is shown only in that reply, so keep it for this conversation.

code.description: The 6-digit confirmation code from the email the buyer received, digits only, e.g. "482913". Ask the buyer for it; never guess (8 attempts per order request).

tools.name: resend_code
tools.description: Email the buyer a new confirmation code when the first did not arrive or expired (30 minutes). Use it only after place_order, when the buyer says no email came (after 10 minutes and a spam check) or the code expired; do not use it to confirm (confirm_order). Needs order_number and order_secret from place_order. At most 2 resends per order request; the old code stops working. Returns status: sent, already (confirmed, nothing to resend), invalid, limit, locked, expired (place a new order request); resends_left and a message.

order_number.description: order_number from the place_order reply: a positive integer, e.g. 1042.

order_secret.description: order_secret from the place_order reply: 32 lowercase hexadecimal characters. Pass it exactly as received; it is shown only in that reply, so keep it for this conversation.
